scope: ordinary electrocharged and burning source-state phase descriptors
status: private patches ready; gofmt/default git apply --check passed on both fresh bases; no build/test

apiDependencies.reason: Reaction live attack/snapshot state delegates to canonical copy-and-normalize implementation. Snapshot SourceFrame is gameplay state and must remain as sourceAgeFrames; all SourceHost receipt metadata is normalized only by the root helper.
apiDependencies.enemyHelper: Enemy.QueueEnemyTaskWithPhase(func(),delay,key,phase.Descriptor), new optional concrete method; original reactable.Enemy and info.Enemy interfaces/type assertions are unchanged.

descriptors.registration: TryAddEC first tick and nextECTick recursive tick
capturedState: src expressed as current core frame minus captured src
current ecTickSrc equality with captured src
descriptors.deadline: Existing task handler executeBy-current native core clock and native FIFO rank; no manual deadline forecast.
descriptors.preservedGuards: ecTickSrc!=src returns, missing Electro or Hydro returns; exact original QueueAttackWithSnap0 then queue next+60.

descriptors.registration: exact original OnEnemyDamage subscription key ec-{targetKey}
liveReferencedState: current target key and elemental durabilities via existing reaction provider
descriptors.notCaptured: n, attack and dmg are runtime event arguments, not persistent closure captures; no generation is invented.
descriptors.preservedGuards: target equality, ECDamage tag, nonzero dmg, electro/hydro presence and original unsubscribe behavior; successful branch registers unchanged+6 task.
descriptors.eventOrdering: SubscribeWithPhase delegates same native subscribe implementation and retains key replacement/slot order; descriptor is not Observational.

liveReferencedState: current Durability/DecayRate, ecTickSrc and event handler state
descriptors.preservation: Still invokes original waneEC only when task executes; observer does not reduce auras, call checkEC, unsubscribe, log or emit. Pending wane applies to live state even after generation changes, exactly as native source.

capturedState: src expressed relative to current core frame
native counter without capping or inferring damage count
captured t queue target reference Key/Type when info.Target is implemented
current burningTickSrc equality with captured src
descriptors.deadline: Native enemy queue executeBy-enemy timePassed and FIFO rank, not global frames. Existing enemy phase state includes frozenFrames and queue provider.
descriptors.counterAudit: Queued task is removed from heap before execution. The pending descriptor records exactly the src/counter/t queue arguments; original task increments its captured counter before creating the next task, whose descriptor receives that incremented value. Counter9 remains the source skip branch; no modulo or saturated counter is invented.
descriptors.preservedGuards: original generation check and both BurningFuel/Burning presence checks unchanged; enemy damage and player self-damage QueueAttackWithSnap order unchanged; original next+15 preserved.
descriptors.compatibilityFallback: Targets implementing original Enemy only still use original QueueEnemyTask. Active burning keeps burning-enemy-task-phase-descriptor-unavailable, and generic queued closure gaps remain. No target is silently removed from the original type assertion domain.

reactionStateChanges.whyRemovalIsBounded: All native ordinary EC task/event registrations and both burning task registrations are now described; reaction live values remain in existing provider. Unknown enemy task implementations retain a specific gap, generic missing task/event providers stay conservative.
reactionStateChanges.retainedGeneration: Existing generationAgeFrames remains for active EC/burning; pending callbacks additionally retain their own capturedGenerationAgeFrames and equality to live generation, including stale tasks. No raw age, counter or deadline is dropped for the sake of phase equality.
reactionStateChanges.snapshot: Root canonical helper copies full gameplay snapshot stats/level plus relative SourceFrame; previous reaction export omission of SourceFrame is corrected.
reactionStateChanges.reactableReference: Descriptor stores exact native target Key/Type rather than serializing or executing r; target and reaction state are already observed by corresponding providers.

laneAudit: The three modified existing source files are byte-identical between verified classic and Stellar bases. Ordinary EC still delegates unchanged to TryAddLC when LunarChargeEnableKey is present; LC and other reaction-specific omissions are not marked complete by this patch.
observerReadAudit: All Observe closures only allocate maps, read captured integers/strings/event enum, read native target identity and compare generation fields.
No Observe closure invokes original nextECTick/nextBurningTick/EC event callback/waneEC or any game callback.
No observer applies attacks, chooses targets, advances a clock, queues tasks, consumes RNG, mutates status/auras or emits events.
Canonical attack/snapshot helpers are root-owned and must not invoke gameplay callbacks; required signatures documented above.
preservedBehavior: Original callback construction occurs once per native registration.
Queue helper does not retarget or convert enemy timers to core timers; delay-zero path exactly mirrors existing QueueEnemyTask.
Source task/event keys and descriptors add observation metadata only; heap insertion order, clock pointer, task count, delays, and gameplay callback body remain unchanged.
No character, finite-cast, producer ownership or registry files changed.
remainingUnknownScope: Undescribed queues/listeners elsewhere still produce their existing gaps.
No claim of Lunar-Charged or unrelated reaction lifecycle coverage.
Target implementations without phase queue support remain explicitly unknown.
Full build/runtime phase-equality validation belongs to root; only gofmt and patch applicability were checked here.
